name: Expressive Language Goals
description: Focus on helping students clearly express thoughts, ideas, and feelings using accurate vocabulary and sentence structure.

goals.name: Sentence Structure
goals.description: Use age-appropriate 4–6 word sentences (subject + verb + object) accurately during structured tasks in 80% of opportunities.

goals.name: Vocabulary Labeling
goals.description: Correctly label pictures or objects with appropriate vocabulary with 80% accuracy across three consecutive sessions.

goals.name: WH-Questions
goals.description: Accurately ask and answer WH-questions (who, what, where, when, why) during structured activities with 75% accuracy.

goals.name: Verb Tenses
goals.description: Use correct verb tenses (present, past) spontaneously in speech with 80% accuracy.

goals.name: Story Retelling
goals.description: Retell short stories or events using a minimum of three sequential events with minimal adult support.

name: Receptive Language Goals
description: Enhance students’ ability to understand spoken language, follow instructions, and grasp main ideas.

goals.name: Following Directions
goals.description: Successfully follow 2- to 3-step directions containing spatial or temporal concepts with 80% accuracy.

goals.name: Main Idea Identification
goals.description: Identify the main idea and key details from spoken paragraphs with 75% accuracy.

goals.name: Object and Descriptor Identification
goals.description: Point to or select named objects, actions, or descriptors during structured activities with 80% accuracy.

goals.name: Vocabulary Understanding
goals.description: Demonstrate comprehension of classroom vocabulary through matching or sorting tasks with 80% accuracy.

name: Articulation Goals
description: Improve speech clarity and sound production to enhance effective communication.

goals.name: Phoneme Production
goals.description: Accurately produce targeted phonemes (/s/, /r/, /th/) in initial, medial, and final positions of words with 80% accuracy.

goals.name: Reduction of Phonological Processes
goals.description: Reduce occurrences of phonological processes (fronting, gliding) in connected speech to less than 20%.

goals.name: Self-monitoring
goals.description: Independently identify and correct speech sound errors during speech production in 3 out of 5 opportunities.

name: Pragmatic/Social Communication Goals
description: Develop skills necessary for successful social interactions, including conversational skills and interpreting social cues.

goals.name: Conversational Skills
goals.description: Initiate and sustain conversations across at least three conversational turns with peers and adults in 80% of opportunities.

goals.name: Social Greetings and Requests
goals.description: Appropriately use greetings, farewells, and polite requests in structured role-play scenarios with 90% accuracy.

goals.name: Emotion and Perspective Recognition
goals.description: Identify emotions and perspectives from visual stimuli or stories and discuss suitable responses with 80% accuracy.

goals.name: Nonverbal Cue Response
goals.description: Appropriately interpret and respond to nonverbal cues, including facial expressions and body language, in 80% of opportunities.

name: Fluency and Voice Goals
description: Target fluent speech patterns and appropriate vocal modulation for clearer communication.

goals.name: Fluency
goals.description: Consistently utilize fluency techniques such as easy onset and pausing during connected speech with 80% accuracy.

goals.name: Vocal Quality
goals.description: Maintain suitable vocal loudness and pitch in everyday conversational settings 80% of the time.
